title: Incheon Airport steps up security amid bomb threats in Europe
caption:
Incheon Airport is increasing security following a series of bomb threats targeting European flights. Authorities confirm there is no direct risk, but are maintaining high vigilance.

Source: Koreaherald - Incheon Airport steps up security amid bomb threats in Europe
